faqs.content: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Customer must initiate return from order page. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the item.
Standard shipping: 5-7 business days. Express: 2-3 business days. We ship from US warehouses for US orders.
If you received wrong item or defective product, please reply with your order ID and photos. We will send replacement or full refund at no extra cost.
Password reset: use 'Forgot password' on login page. For account merge or access issues, provide registered email and we will verify identity.

tone: Professional, friendly, and concise. Reply in English for US customers. Avoid jargon; use simple sentences.
